header.title: GWAS Explorer
descriptionLines: Query PanKgraph GWAS to explore associations for Type 1 Diabetes (T1D).
Configure your question below to proceed to GWAS results.

singleQuestion.template: Does [SNP] have GWAS association with T1D?

shared.traitText: PanKgraph GWAS is focused on Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) and uses a fixed population of individuals from the T1D meta-analysis cohorts.
shared.whatNextDescription: We will check whether your SNP is included in PanKgraph GWAS and redirect you to the GWAS results page with summary statistics, association context, and links to relevant genes and pathways.
shared.securityNote: All queries are processed securely. No data will be stored.
shared.bottomSearchPlaceholder: Ask about GWAS, SNPs, methods, or results... (e.g., "What is this SNP associated with in T1D?")
shared.bottomSearchHint: Your message will be sent with the current configuration context.

rightPanel.aboutBody: PanKgraph GWAS integrates summary statistics from large-scale studies focused on Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) and related traits.
importantBodyLines: This tool is for exploratory lookup and knowledge discovery.
It does not perform statistical analysis or fine-mapping.
whyItems: Instantly check SNPs in PanKgraph GWAS datasets
Explore trait associations and study context
Seamlessly connect to PanKgraph knowledge network

examples.text: Does rs1016432 have GWAS association with T1D?
